description:
Identify all concrete classes that implement the 'IMessageHandler' interface in the 'MessageSystem' project. This includes classes that implement it directly AND classes that inherit it through an abstract base class. 

Create a file named 'handler_audit.txt' in the project root directory. For each concrete implementation found, add a line with the format: 'ClassName: [Javadoc Description]'.

Do not include abstract classes or interfaces in the list. The description should be the text found in the class-level Javadoc.
